verdict.rationale: Calendly's pricing page lists in-product AI features: meeting recaps and action items, recordings and transcripts, and an AI assistant 'to help with the work around meetings.' The homepage adds that next steps are tracked and follow-ups handled. These are AI-generated outputs from meeting data, but they are thin marketing one-liners, not documented insight or suggestion features over the user's scheduling data. Missing for 10: AI insights or suggestions over scheduling, booking and routing data, in-depth docs on how recaps and suggestions are generated and surfaced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
